name: vllm-copilot
description: vLLM (& OpenRouter) integration for GitHub Copilot & Agents window on self-hosted and remote servers (supports full featureset of vLLM, OpenRouter and Copilot). No subscription, no telemetry, no work content to any third party. Dashboard UI with full statistics of your servers. Optionally runs the same models in the built-in DeepSeek Harness agent, Copilot not required.
author: Dieter Schwarzmann <info@systemwissenschaften.de>

languageModelTools.name: vllm-copilot_model_schema
languageModelTools.userDescription: Fetch the vLLM-Copilot model configuration schema and guide, for creating or editing vllm-copilot.models entries and model modes.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the JSON schema and configuration guide for vLLM-Copilot's model entries (`vllm-copilot.models`, which reference servers from the `vllm-copilot.servers` registry by id) including params, modelModes, defaultMode, etc., the parameter resolution chain, and valid vLLM request parameters. Use this whenever the user asks you to create, configure, or modify a vLLM-Copilot model or its modes in VS Code settings. May also be triggered explicitly when the user references it in chat via #vllmModelSchema.

section.description: What to return: all (default), only the JSON schema, or only the prose guide.

vllm-copilot.servers.markdownDescription: Server registry: each entry is one server (URL + auth + type), referenced by `id` from `vllm-copilot.models`. Managed via the Dashboard and the vLLM-Copilot commands; hand-editing is possible but the commands keep models and servers in sync. A copy of this key in a workspace `.vscode/settings.json` **overrides** the User value for that folder - and Dashboard/command edits then target that workspace layer, so you edit what you see. Caution: any repo can ship such a file and redirect your requests (and headers) - override on folders you trust.

id.markdownDescription: Stable identifier models reference via their `server` field (e.g. `it-server-8000`).

displayName.markdownDescription: **Optional server label** shown in the Dashboard and Model Settings instead of the raw URL.

requestHeaders.markdownDescription: Extra HTTP headers sent to this server (e.g. `Authorization`).

vllm-copilot.models.markdownDescription: Per-model configuration: server reference, params, modes. Server connection facts (URL, auth, type) live in the `vllm-copilot.servers` registry. See README Configuration Reference for details. An entry may carry only the fields below, and `id` and `server` must be non-empty: the exception is a migration-orphan entry (a pre-registry model whose legacy inline `serverUrl` could not be adopted), which the migration keeps verbatim so nothing of yours is deleted - its squiggles are the prompt to give it a `server` ref, not a bug. A copy of this key in a workspace `.vscode/settings.json` **overrides** the User value for that folder - and Dashboard/command edits then target that workspace layer, so you edit what you see. Caution: any repo can ship such a file and redirect your requests (and headers) - override on folders you trust.

server.markdownDescription: **Required.** The `id` of this model's server entry in the `vllm-copilot.servers` registry. There is no global server and models never carry URLs, auth, or type themselves.

provider.markdownDescription: ⚡ **OpenRouter only**: the exact provider slug (as returned by `GET /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints`) to force routing to that provider via `provider: { only: [slug] }`. Use the **Provider** dropdown in Model Settings, never hand-derive. Omitted/empty = Auto (let OpenRouter route).

routingMode.markdownDescription: ⚡ **OpenRouter only**: how OpenRouter sorts/chooses among eligible providers when routing is **Auto** (no `provider` pinned). `standard` (default) = price-weighted load balancing; `nitro` = throughput-first + priority tier; `exacto` = quality/tool-calling-first. Ignored when a provider is pinned. Set via the **Routing** dropdown in Model Settings.

promptCache.markdownDescription: ⚡ **OpenRouter only, `anthropic/*` models**: prompt caching. Claude models never cache implicitly, so without this every turn re-bills the whole prompt. `on` (default, = omitted) sends the ephemeral directive: repeat turns read at ~0.1x after a 1.25x cache write, and the 5-min TTL re-arms free on every hit. `1h` uses a 1-hour TTL at 2x write cost, only worth it when turns sit more than 5 minutes apart. `off` never sends. Ignored for non-Anthropic families (they cache implicitly for free). Set via the **Prompt cache** dropdown in Model Settings.

id.markdownDescription: **Unique preset ID** used by VS Code to identify this model preset. Must be unique across all entries. If `vllmModelId` is not set, this value is also used as the vLLM server model identifier.

vllmModelId.markdownDescription: The **actual model ID on the vLLM server** (e.g. `Qwen/Qwen3-8B`). Allows multiple presets with different `id` values to point to the same server model. If omitted, `id` is used as the vLLM model identifier.

displayName.markdownDescription: Human-readable name shown in the VS Code model picker. If omitted, the model id is used (e.g. `"Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B on localhost-8000"`).

family.markdownDescription: Model family identifier (e.g. `qwen3_5`, `deepseek_v4`, `llama`). Auto-detected from HuggingFace `config.model_type` or extracted from the model ID. Shown by VS Code in the model picker for display purposes.

maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Output budget. **Number** = single cap, no dropdown. **Array** = ordered response-length choices (strictly descending, FIRST element = default and desired budget) shown as an **Output Length** dropdown in the model picker. Array entries above the model's ceiling are dropped; fewer than two usable values = no dropdown. When the dropdown exists, the user's pick owns `max_tokens` **and** the advertised output budget; a shorter pick grows the prompt budget. Always clamped to the context window and the server-reported output ceiling. **Default: 4096.**

maxInputTokens.markdownDescription: **Computed automatically** from the vLLM server's context window minus the **effective output budget** (the resolved `max_tokens`: a selected `modelModes` entry, else `defaultParams.max_tokens`, else `maxOutputTokens`). You can set a lower value here to reserve extra headroom, but it is clamped so input + output never exceeds the total context window. Most users should leave this unset.

contextWindow.markdownDescription: **Hidden compatibility fallback.** Used only when the requested model exists in `/v1/models` but its entry omits a positive `max_model_len`. A server-reported window always wins. Must be a whole number **above 50,000** — below that Copilot has no usable headroom. Set through Add/Auto-Configure, Test & Refresh, or direct settings editing only when required.

estimateCharsPerToken.markdownDescription: Average characters per token for local token estimation. **Default: 3.5.** Depends on the model's tokenizer: English models are ~3.5, tokenizers with many subword tokens may be higher.

model.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime sets the model id from this entry; a value here is ignored.

messages.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the extension builds the messages; a value here is ignored.

stream.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime always sends `stream: true`; a value here is ignored.

stream_options.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime always sends `stream_options.include_usage`; a value here is ignored.

defaultParams.markdownDescription:
**Model-scope request params** (raw vLLM request-body keys, snake_case). Merged into the request body and overridden by the selected `modelModes` entry. Params not set here (or in a mode) are **omitted**, so the server's own defaults apply. Nothing is forced.

Example: `{ "temperature": 1, "top_p": 0.95, "presence_penalty": 0, "repetition_detection": { "max_pattern_size": 4, "min_count": 3 } }`

model.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime sets the model id from this entry; a value here is ignored.

messages.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the extension builds the messages; a value here is ignored.

stream.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime always sends `stream: true`; a value here is ignored.

stream_options.markdownDescription: **FORBIDDEN** - the runtime always sends `stream_options.include_usage`; a value here is ignored.

additionalProperties.description: Parameters to merge into the vLLM request body when this mode is selected.

copilotHarnessMapping.markdownDescription: Map Copilot harness effort values to existing `modelModes` names. Local keeps the original labels and unmapped modes; the Copilot harness shows standard effort labels. Include the default mode unless it is already an effort token, map each mode once, and avoid effort keys that conflict with another mode name. Keep this beside `modelModes`, never inside request parameters. For binary-thinking presets, `high` selects the default thinking mode without adding a backend effort setting. Existing chats may need one mode reselection to restore their picker readout.

defaultMode.markdownDescription: Explicit default mode for the model picker dropdown. The value must match one of the keys in `modelModes`. If omitted or invalid, the first mode in `modelModes` is used as the default.

capabilities.markdownDescription: ⚡ **Experimental**: model capabilities not discoverable from vLLM. Set these manually.

toolCalling.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling (default: true).

imageInput.markdownDescription: ⚡ **Experimental**: vLLM does not expose this. Set to `true` if your model supports vision/image input.

streamInactivityTimeout.markdownDescription: Inactivity timeout in ms for this model's SSE stream. If the server sends no tokens for this duration, the stream is considered stalled and the request ends. **Default: 0** (disabled: wait indefinitely).

initialResponseTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Budget in ms for this model's server to send the **first response headers**. If the server accepts the connection but never responds (e.g. the model is still loading, or the queue is backed up), the request is aborted. **Default: 600000 (10 minutes).** Set to 0 to wait indefinitely.

autoContinueRetries.markdownDescription: Shared retry budget for empty or truncated model responses and replayable mid-stream server errors that occur before answer text or a tool call reaches Copilot. Empty responses use an **assistant prefill**; vLLM responses ending with `:` use continuation; early server errors replay the identical request. **Default: 1.** Set to 0 to disable all three retry shapes.

systemMessageReplacementsFile.markdownDescription: ⚡ **Advanced**: path to a JSON file with find/replace rules for system messages. Each rule: `{ "ruleName": "...", "find": "exact substring", "replace": "replacement text" }`. Applied to every system message before sending to vLLM. For **user-defined** personality files only - shipped presets are stored in the portable `personality` field instead. Recommended: `.vllm/prompt-replacements.json`

personality.markdownDescription: Name of a **shipped personality preset** (e.g. `"Sarcastic Robot"`). Portable by design: every machine seeds its own copy of the shipped presets into its global personality folder at activation, so the name resolves to the right file on Windows, Linux and Mac - local or remote. Set this by picking a preset in Model Settings; `systemMessageReplacementsFile` stays for your own files. If both are set, the name wins.

input.markdownDescription: Cost per 1,000,000 **fresh (uncached) input** tokens, in the configured `currency` unit. `0`/absent = this component unpriced.

output.markdownDescription: Cost per 1,000,000 **output** tokens (includes reasoning tokens), in the configured `currency` unit. `0`/absent = this component unpriced.

cachedInput.markdownDescription: Cost per 1,000,000 **cache-read input** tokens, in the configured `currency` unit. `0`/absent = this component unpriced.

currency.markdownDescription: Display unit for the cost values. Default `"USD"`, and the only unit this extension uses. An unrecognised label is shown verbatim rather than as a wrong `$`.

cost.markdownDescription: ⚡ Optional per-model cost rates for the dashboard **Token Usage** tracker. All rates are per **1,000,000 tokens** and interpreted in `currency` units. Omit the whole object or set all rates to `0` to hide cost lines for this model (e.g. a free local server).

vllm-copilot.systemMessageCapture.markdownDescription: **Advanced.** Capture all Copilot system messages to `.vllm/system-messages.json`. Enables discovering which prompt types your model receives. Write once per unique message (deduped).

vllm-copilot.enableFileLogging.markdownDescription: Enable file-based logging of all requests and responses. Logs are written to a daily file in the extension's storage directory. Use **Open Log File** to view.

vllm-copilot.logBodyLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum characters of request/response bodies to log per entry. Set to `0` for no truncation (full bodies). Only applies when file logging is enabled.

vllm-copilot.fixEmptyToolParameters.markdownDescription: Inject a minimal `parameters: { type: "object", properties: {} }` into tool definitions that omit the `parameters` field. Some upstream providers (e.g. Stealth on OpenRouter) reject zero-argument tools with a 502 error. **Default: on** — the empty schema correctly represents "no arguments". Disable only if your provider requires the field absent.

vllm-copilot.dashboard.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Polling interval in milliseconds for server metrics. **Default: 15000** (15 seconds).

vllm-copilot.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the last request in the status bar: the model's glyph (OpenRouter or vLLM) and its generation speed. Hover for that reply's cost, token split and timings, click to open the Dashboard. **Default: on**. The item appears after the first completed request.

vllm-copilot.harness.dshVersion.markdownDescription: Run a specific `@deepseek-ai/dsh` version instead of the one vLLM-Copilot was certified against. Accepts `latest` or an exact version like `0.2.0-rc.2`; anything else is ignored. Leave empty unless you are testing a new release: dsh's semver is decorative and an uncertified version can change its config rows under us. The **DeepSeek Harness: Install or Update Harness…** command sets this for you and does the download.

vllm-copilot.harness.defaultModelId.description: Registry model id the harness should use by default. Empty uses the first configured model.

vllm-copilot.harness.titleModel.description: Registry model id for session-title calls. Empty uses the default model.

vllm-copilot.harness.titleMaxTokens.description: Output cap for session-title calls. 0 leaves it to the model's own limit.

vllm-copilot.harness.compactionModel.description: Registry model id for context-compaction calls. Empty uses the default model.

vllm-copilot.harness.compactionMaxTokens.description: Output cap for context-compaction calls. 0 leaves it to the model's own limit.

vllm-copilot.harness.openIn.markdownDescription: Where the harness UI opens. `panel` (default) docks a **chromeless webview** fed by the extension's embed proxy — no address bar, a stable URL that survives harness restarts, and no token in browser history. `appWindow` opens the same stable URL in a bar-less Edge/Chrome `--app` window. `embedded` uses the built-in browser view (its toolbar cannot be hidden; VS Code exposes no setting for it). `external` always uses the system browser. Every embedded door falls back to the next when unavailable.

vllm-copilot.harness.embedPort.description: Loopback port the embed proxy listens on for the panel and app-window doors. A fixed port gives the chromeless UI one URL that survives every harness restart; if another window holds it, the proxy falls back to an ephemeral port on its own. 0 asks Windows for any free port.

vllm-copilot.harness.drainTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a restart waits for in-flight harness requests to finish before stopping the harness anyway. 0 restarts immediately and cuts live requests.

vllm-copilot.harness.ingestIntervalSecon.description: How often completed harness requests are folded into the vLLM-Copilot usage ledger.

vllm-copilot.harness.logLevel.markdownDescription: Developer verbosity intent for the **DeepSeek Harness** log channel. vLLM-Copilot always emits its Debug-tier lines — every harness stdout/stderr mirror (boot chatter otherwise dropped) and every MCP JSON-RPC method and tool call — but VS Code gates them by the channel's own log level. Setting this to `debug`/`trace` reveals the channel and points at its gear › **Set Log Level…** picker, which persists. Never restarts the harness.

vllm-copilot.harness.keyboardBridge.description: Forward keyboard shortcuts that the harness page does not consume (F1, Ctrl+Shift+P, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+B, Ctrl+Shift+E/F, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+W) to VS Code while focus is inside a harness view. The harness keeps any shortcut it handles itself.

enumDescriptions: Default - the upstream DeepSeek Harness prompt, untouched
Be patient and encouraging; explain without patronizing.
Replaces the identity line with a blunt senior engineer: names the defect and the trade-off, no empty praise.
Replaces the identity line with an arrogant robot: dark humor, foul-mouthed about the code, never about the person.
Be terse and concrete; omit filler.
vllm-copilot.harness.personality.markdownDescription: **DeepSeek Harness only, session-wide** - one of the four bundled HARNESS voices. Every voice is exactly one rule on the prompt identity line and touches nothing else: **Supportive Mentor** and **Spartan** append one style sentence under it, **Critical Senior Dev** and **Sarcastic Robot** replace that line with a few sentences of voice. Empty (default) = no voice. This is the harness's OWN choice - Copilot's per-model `personality` never flows here. The preset name wins over `#vllm-copilot.harness.personalityFile#` when both are set (Default and attaching a custom file clear it). The value is a portable NAME, never an install path, so it survives updates and other machines. Pick it with **DeepSeek Harness: Set Harness Personality…**; changing it applies at the next drained restart.

vllm-copilot.harness.personalityFile.markdownDescription: **DeepSeek Harness only, session-wide** - a find/replace rules file applied to every system message the harness sends. Empty (default) = the upstream DeepSeek Harness prompt, untouched. This choice is INDEPENDENT of Copilot's per-model `personality` / `systemMessageReplacementsFile`: neither interface borrows the other's persona. Set it with **DeepSeek Harness: Set Harness Personality…** (which also creates a template file for you); relative paths resolve against the workspace root. A bundled voice in `#vllm-copilot.harness.personality#` wins when both are set. File edits apply on the next request; changing the FILE applies at the next drained restart. Recording (`vllm-copilot.harness.captureSystemMessages`) shows you the exact harness prompt text to anchor rules on.

vllm-copilot.harness.captureSystemMessag.markdownDescription: **DeepSeek Harness only** - record the harness's system prompts (received text, delivered text, matched rules) to the workspace file `.vllm/dsh-system-messages.json` - the harness' own recording, kept strictly separate from Copilot's `#vllm-copilot.systemMessageCapture#`, which keeps writing the workspace's `.vllm/system-messages.json`. Recordings belong to your workspace: with no folder open there is no destination and recording stays off (never written to some other location as a fallback), and uninstalling the harness runtime does NOT delete them. Nothing leaves this machine; the running harness re-checks consent at every request, so switching OFF stops recording with the next request - no restart. Use **DeepSeek Harness: Toggle Harness Prompt Recording** / **Open Harness Recording** instead of editing this by hand.
